data.title: Search stems plurals, -ed and -ing; ranks from a tenth of the question and answers only when its best record holds 0.35
data.why: Measured on the frozen corpus (pin 01M3XZ6N…, 1124 events) against the 50 held-out questions and 15 off-topic developer questions written before measuring. Before: held-out top-1/3/5 27/33/35, silent on 3, golden 19/25, off-topic answered 2/15. After: 26/38/40, silent on 1, golden 18/25 (floor 17), off-topic 4/15 — every off-topic answer at coverage 0.40-0.44, below the 0.7 at which the output already says it answers only part (DEC-30). The split gate alone moves little (27/34/37); stemming is what moves the top three. Search end to end 140-160 ms, a query in-process 32 ms (was 28).
data.rejected: Silence at 0.45 to absorb what stemming adds to coverage: off-topic 0/15, but held-out 24/36/38 — two first places and two top-three answers lost to prevent two flagged near-misses; Porter stemming: folds general into gener and university into univers, trading the precision a lexical search lives on
